PeerJS and the modules it imports, as jsDelivr builds them (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<package>@<version>/+esm),
with their imports pointed at these local files. Served with the game so multiplayer needs no CDN and the App Store
app runs no code fetched at run time.

peerjs 1.5.4               MIT          https://github.com/peers/peerjs
peerjs-js-binarypack 2.1.0 MIT          https://github.com/peers/js-binarypack
@msgpack/msgpack 2.8.0     ISC          https://github.com/msgpack/msgpack-javascript
webrtc-adapter 9.0.1       BSD-3-Clause https://github.com/webrtcHacks/adapter
sdp 3.2.0                  MIT          https://github.com/fippo/sdp
